question: The accuracy of measurement using a try square is approximately _______.
solution:
**Concept**

 
• A try square is a precision measuring instrument used to check the squareness (90° angle) of a surface.
 
• It is also used to check the flatness of a surface and to mark lines at right angles to an edge.
 
• The accuracy of a try square is defined by the degree of deviation of the blade from the stock.

**Explanation**

The try square consists of a stock and a blade. For engineering purposes, high-quality try squares are manufactured to specific tolerances. According to standard workshop practice and manufacturing specifications:

 
• T
